title: Exact Global Minimax Risk near Nonidentification
abstract: arXiv:2610.32546v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study squared-error estimation when a nuisance parameter is unidentified on a submodel but affects a target that vanishes there. For models with higher-order profile expansions, we give sufficient conditions under which the largest critical-path minimax risk is the exact asymptotic minimax risk over the full parameter space. An efficient observable feature, negligible calibration error and stable recovery yield one estimator attaining the leading constant uniformly, with the profile coordinates unknown. The estimator uses calibration estimates, a local feature mean and an empirical recovery feature. The constant is expressed through a bounded-normal decision problem. We verify the conditions in two models. In centered Gaussian logistic errors-in-variables regression with one surrogate and two unknown variances, we determine the fifth-order global coefficient risk and its exact constant. translated_title: 非识别点附近的精确全局极小极大风险
translated_abstract: 我们研究当某个冗余参数在一个子模型上不可识别、但其会影响一个在该处趋于消失的目标量时的平方误差估计问题。对于具有高阶剖面展开的模型，我们给出了充分条件，使得最大的临界路径极小极大风险恰为整个参数空间上的精确渐近极小极大风险。一个高效的可见特征、可忽略的校准误差以及稳定的恢复机制，使得单个估计量能够在剖面坐标未知的情况下一致地达到首项常数。该估计量利用了校准估计、局部特征均值以及一个经验恢复特征。该常数通过一个有界正态决策问题来刻画。我们在两个模型中验证了这些条件。在具有一个代理变量和两个未知方差的中心化高斯logistic误差变量回归模型中，我们确定了五阶全局系数风险及其精确常数。一个稀疏扩展将方差分解……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文给出了在冗余参数非识别点附近，最大临界路径极小极大风险等于全参数空间精确渐近极小极大风险的充分条件，并构造了能一致达到该精确首项常数的估计量，且在含未知方差的logistic误差变量回归中确定出五阶精确风险常数。
en_tdlr: The paper establishes sufficient conditions under which the largest critical-path minimax risk equals the exact asymptotic minimax risk over the full parameter space near nonidentification, and constructs an estimator uniformly attaining the exact leading constant, verified by determining the fifth-order risk constant in logistic errors-in-variables regression with unknown variances.
